desc:
Thanks For Playing.

Join Discord Server To See Every Update Logs.

LIMITED TIME: PLAY FOR 5 MINUTES FOR EXCLUSIVE COSMETICS! ⚠️⚠️

Train, Fight to be the strongest sorcerer.

📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)

⭐ Support the Game
This would be a great help for us to bring more updates, abilities, and maps; so, please consider liking and favoriting the game!

Controls:
G - Ultimate mode
F - Block
Q - Dash
Q (While Ragdolled) - Ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - Run
Left Click - Punch
B - Emote wheel

This game includes randomized rewards (emotes and spins). All items have an equal chance of being obtained. No duplicates are possible.
